_doc: Rules or preferences that contradict the kit. A matching line in a CLAUDE.md, output style, skill or agent is replaced with the kit line; a matching memory file is deleted (backup kept) and its MEMORY.md line removed. Scopes: claude_md, memory, output_style, skill, agent. Patterns are case-insensitive. Keep them specific: a false positive deletes a useful memory.

rules.re: (\b(run|do|execute|apply|deploy)\b[^.\n]{0,40}\b(prod|production|vps|live server|live site)\b[^.\n]{0,80}\b(yourself|without asking|just do it|no need to ask|never ask))|never ask me to run|(deploy|push) (straight |directly )?to (prod|production) (without|freely)
